channel.title: Mauritius - The African Street Journal
channel.description: Daily news from Mauritius, every source cited.

item.title: Mauritius cabinet considers lowering age of criminal responsibility
item.description: Government examines prosecuting 12-year-olds after recent riots, but legal experts and child rights groups raise concerns.

item.title: Mauritians honour ancestors with cemetery rituals
item.description: Families across the island spent November 1 and 2 cleaning and decorating graves for All Saints' Day and All Souls' Day.

item.title: Menlo Park demands $19.55 million from Bank of Mauritius
item.description: Company claims former central bank governor Rama Sithanen sought commission on financing deal before his appointment.

item.title: Mauritius police arrest man over TikTok video
item.description: A 25-year-old man faces a provisional charge of child ill-treatment after a video circulated online.
